facts: Brown analysed thousands of interviews and split people into worthiness and inadequacy groups.
Perfectionism is a twenty-ton shield that prevents taking flight.
If I look perfect, act perfect, I can avoid shame, judgment and blame.
Perfectionism is other-focused (what will people think); healthy striving is self-focused (how can I improve).
Shame, judgment or blame after the fact are blamed on not being perfect enough, feeding the loop.
Subtitle and ten guideposts; perfectionism under self-compassion.
